lines.japanese: 「うーん、ううーん」
lines.english: “Hmm. Hmmmm.”

lines.japanese: 先代はしばらく唸り声をあげていた。
lines.english: The former king spent some time groaning in thought.

lines.japanese: 「無駄なことを」
lines.english: “A fruitless exercise.”

lines.japanese: まだ幼い彼は、我々の平和的共存を希求している。そんなものは現実に背を向けた子供の夢想に過ぎない。
lines.english: Young as he was, he yearned for peaceful coexistence among us. It was nothing more than a child's dream, born of turning his back on reality.

lines.japanese: だがここでは時間が有りあまっている。無為な思索で暇をつぶすも一興であろう。どのみち考えること以外の遊戯などないのだから。
lines.english: But here we had time in profusion. There was a certain pleasure in passing it with idle thought. After all, thought was the only diversion afforded us.

lines.japanese: そこで私は、地上から持ちかえってきたさまざまな現実的感覚を思いおこして感慨にふけった。
lines.english: And so I recalled the many sensations of reality I had brought back from the surface, and surrendered myself to reminiscence.

lines.japanese: 街のさんざめきが四方八方から降ってくる感覚。
lines.english: The sensation of a city's murmur raining down from every side.

lines.japanese: 冬の匂いが鼻腔を突きぬけて嗅細胞を刺す感覚。
lines.english: The scent of winter spearing through the nostrils to sting the olfactory cells.

lines.japanese: 風の冷たさが肌を粟立たせ筋肉を震わせる感覚。
lines.english: The cold of the wind raising gooseflesh and setting the muscles trembling.

lines.japanese: 奈落にいた頃はこうした貴重な現実みやげを、しばしば嗜好品として味わったものだ。
lines.english: In the Abyss, I had often savored such precious souvenirs of reality as luxuries.

lines.japanese: 「フゥーッ……」
lines.english: “Foooo...”

lines.japanese: 私は想い出たばこに心の火を灯し、まんふまんふと打ちふるえていた。肉体を持たぬ身に沁みいる実感が、甘やかな懐かしさとして──
lines.english: I lit a cigarette of memory with the flame of my heart and quivered—manfu, manfu—in exquisite delight. For one without a body, the vivid sensation sank deep, a sweet nostalgia—

lines.japanese: ジュッ。
lines.english: Sssst.

lines.japanese: ──戦いの嚆矢が放たれたのはそのときだった。
lines.english: —and at that moment, the opening shot of battle was loosed.

lines.japanese: 貴重な現実みやげのもたらす甘い感動が、突如として霧散した。
lines.english: The sweet rapture bestowed by my precious souvenir of reality vanished in an instant.

lines.japanese: 文字通りの一番矢が私の≪精髄≫に突きたち、その矢羽根をみんみん震わせていた。
lines.english: A literal first arrow stood embedded in my *essence*, its fletching thrumming from the impact.

lines.japanese: 「何をするか……」
lines.english: “What is the meaning of this...?”

lines.japanese: 私は矢を抜いて握りつぶした。実体のない心象兵器は塵と化して消える。
lines.english: I plucked out the arrow and crushed it in my hand. The bodiless weapon of imagination crumbled to dust and vanished.

lines.japanese: 「何をするか貴様ァ！」
lines.english: “What is the meaning of this, you wretch!”

lines.japanese: 彼方上空の射撃手めがけ、私は怒号と眼光を射返した。
lines.english: I fired back a roar and a murderous glare at the archer high in the distance.

lines.japanese: 「おーこわ」
lines.english: “Ooh, scary.”

lines.japanese: そこにはグレタガルド随一といわれる弓の名手がいた。久遠の翼イーグル・イエローグリーンが、私を見下ろして不敵に笑う。
lines.english: There stood the finest bowman in all Gretagard: Eagle Yellow-Green, the Eternal Wing, looking down upon me with a fearless grin.

lines.japanese: 「懐かしいねえ、ウィングクエストごっこ。すべてはここから始まった、みたいな？」
lines.english: “This takes me back—playing *Wing Quest*. Kinda like everything started here, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「おー、イーグル！　おまい、昔のことおぼえてたのか」
lines.english: “Hey, Eagle! You remembered the old days?”

lines.japanese: 「おひさー、ヨージ君。いやあ、そこの性悪妖術師に話しかけられるまでは、すっかり忘れてたんだけどね」
lines.english: “Long time no see, Yoji. Honestly, I'd forgotten all about them until that nasty sorcerer over there started talking to me.”

lines.japanese: 「いまだって、ぜんぶ思いだしたわけじゃないし。おかげでほら、武器は出せたんだけど、防具がいまいちイメージできなくて。まあいいけどね、っと！」
lines.english: “I still don't remember everything. I managed to conjure my weapon, as you can see, but I can't quite picture the armor. Ah, well—take this!”

lines.japanese: 空の右手に生みだした矢をつがえ、放つ。
lines.english: He nocked an arrow formed in his empty right hand and let fly.

lines.japanese: 「猪口才な」
lines.english: “Petty tricks.”

lines.japanese: 私は砂袋をひと振り、土くれの壁を立てて攻撃を受けとめ──
lines.english: With one sweep of my sandbag, I raised a wall of earth to receive the blow—

lines.japanese: 「俺の左上に立つな、久遠の翼！」
lines.english: “Stand not in the square above and left of me, Eternal Wing!”

lines.japanese: ──直後その壁を端から切りくずし、無数のつぶてとして撃ちだした。
lines.english: —then sliced the wall apart from one end and hurled its fragments back as a storm of missiles.

lines.japanese: 「いやだね」
lines.english: “No, thank you.”

lines.japanese: イーグルは高速連射の弾道を置き去りに、弧を描く軌道で宙を翔ける。私の背後を取る算段らしい。
lines.english: Eagle left the high-speed barrage behind, soaring through the air in a broad arc. He evidently meant to get behind me.

lines.japanese: 「うひょー、イーグルちょっぱや！　かるらも負けんなー、どっちもがんばれー」
lines.english: “Whoa, Eagle's super fast! Don't lose, Karura! Both of you do your best!”

lines.japanese: 「ばふん！　相も変わらず腰ぬけ道化が、降りてこいと言うておろう！」
lines.english: “Bah! Still the same cowardly fool. I command you to come down!”

lines.japanese: 「いまどき近接戦闘なんて流行んないよ。人と人ってのは、こうね、ちょっとぐらい離れてる方がいいわけよ、っと！」
lines.english: “Close combat's out of style these days. People are better off keeping a little distance from each other—like this!”

lines.japanese: こちらが土塊弾を撃ちつくした隙に、敵は素早く一矢二矢と射かけてくる。
lines.english: While I exhausted my volley of earthen shot, the enemy swiftly sent one arrow after another against me.

lines.japanese: 私は油瓶の中身を霧状に降りまき、迫る矢を射線のなかばで燃やしつくした。
lines.english: I scattered the contents of an oil flask in a fine mist, burning the oncoming arrows to ash midway along their path.

lines.japanese: 「見える、見えるぞ。なんだその攻撃は、もはは、かつての名射手も泰平の世で遊興にふけっているうち腕が鈍ったようだ、もはははん」
lines.english: “I see them. I see them all! What manner of attack is this? Mohaha! The great archer of old has dulled his skills on the amusements of peacetime! Mohahaha!”

lines.japanese: 「丁度いいハンデじゃない？　あんたに直接会うのは初めてだけど、たしかゲームの中じゃガルーダってキャラは、遠距離戦が不得意だったよねえ」
lines.english: “Call it a fair handicap. This is the first time I've met you in person, but if memory serves, Garuda was pretty bad at long-range combat in the game.”

lines.japanese: 「そーそ、ようじゅつしってヘンなまほうばっかで、チョー使いにくいクラスなんだでー」
lines.english: “That's right. Sorcerers have nothing but weird spells. They're a super-hard class to use.”

lines.japanese: 「わけの分からぬ戯れ言を。遊びなどではない、これは互いの生死と尊厳をかけた死闘なのだ！」
lines.english: “Meaningless babble. This is no game! It is a mortal struggle in which we wager life and dignity alike!”

lines.japanese: なりふり構ってはいられない。私は右手を足元へ叩きつけ、自ら忌まわしき魂の牢獄に強制交信した。
lines.english: There was no room left for restraint. I slammed my right hand against the ground and forced communion with that accursed prison of souls.

lines.japanese: 「奈落よ、母なる深淵よ！　汝が子に力を貸せ！　左上なる神座を穢す、蝋が翼を溶かしつくさん！」
lines.english: “O Abyss, mother of us all! Lend thy child thy strength! Melt the waxen wings that defile the divine throne above and to my left!”

lines.japanese: 奈落は我が祈りに一瞬で応えた。イーグルの体が不安定に傾ぐ。
lines.english: The Abyss answered my prayer in an instant. Eagle's body lurched unsteadily.

lines.japanese: 「お、おおっ！？　ちょちょちょ、ちょっと待て……！」
lines.english: “Wh-whoa!? Wait, wait, wait just a second...!”

lines.japanese: 敵は奈落の重力におぼれ、空中で無様にもがくが、光の園で生きてきた軟弱な精神で抗えるはずもない。揚力を奪われた飛べない鳥は、緩やかに、しかし確実に高度を落としはじめた。
lines.english: The enemy floundered wretchedly in the air, drowning in the gravity of the Abyss. His feeble spirit, raised in the garden of light, could never resist it. Robbed of lift, the flightless bird began to lose altitude, slowly but inexorably.

lines.japanese: 「引導を渡してやる」
lines.english: “I shall deliver your last rites.”

lines.japanese: 私は触媒袋から掴みとった石鹸を足元へ落とし、ブーツの底で踏みくだいた。
lines.english: I took a cake of soap from my reagent pouch, dropped it at my feet, and ground it beneath my boot.

lines.japanese: 「行くぞ愚弟」
lines.english: “Here I come, foolish brother.”

lines.japanese: 中腰の姿勢で両脚を重心低く固定したまま、マナの推力のみで滑るように発進した。経路を虹色の泡沫が無数に立ちのぼってゆく。
lines.english: I fixed my legs in a low crouch and launched forward, gliding on mana thrust alone. Countless iridescent bubbles rose in my wake.

lines.japanese: 「うひゃあ、シャボン玉きれー！　すげー、ホバーいどうだ！」
lines.english: “Whoa, the bubbles are pretty! Awesome—he's hover-gliding!”

lines.japanese: 魔術の触媒を扱えるよう片手は空けておき、残る手でロッドを構える。
lines.english: I kept one hand free to manipulate my magical reagents and leveled my rod with the other.

lines.japanese: 「いざ尋常に、勝負！」
lines.english: “Now face me in honorable combat!”

lines.japanese: 「いやだっての……」
lines.english: “I said no...”

lines.japanese: イーグルは降下中の傾いた姿勢から、背中に手を伸ばし、有りもしない矢筒から次弾を引きぬいた。五指の隙間に四本の矢。
lines.english: Still tilted in his descent, Eagle reached behind his back and drew his next volley from a quiver that did not exist. Four arrows filled the spaces between his fingers.

lines.japanese: 「えーと名前うろ覚えだけど、必殺！　ほにゃらら乱れ撃ち！」
lines.english: “Uh, I don't quite remember the name, but—special attack! Something-or-Other Barrage!”

lines.japanese: 一斉につがえ、一斉にはなつ。
lines.english: He nocked them as one and loosed them as one.

lines.japanese: 「遅い！　かつての神業もいまやその程度か！」
lines.english: “Too slow! Is that all that remains of your once-divine skill?”

lines.japanese: 私は滑走速度を落とすことなく、右に左に切りかえして全弾たやすくやり過ごした。
lines.english: Without sacrificing speed, I veered right and left and let every shaft sail harmlessly past.

lines.japanese: 「一発も！？　うそーん、いまの奥儀かなり高レベル技だったはずよ？」
lines.english: “Not one hit!? No way! I'm pretty sure that was a seriously high-level secret technique.”

lines.japanese: 「イーグル、最近ウイクエやってなかっただろー。ゲームはずっとやってなきゃヘタッピになんだぞ」
lines.english: “Eagle, you haven't played Wing Quest lately, have you? You gotta keep playing games or you get bad at them.”

lines.japanese: 「おおお大人には他にいっぱいやることがあんのッ！」
lines.english: “A-adults have lots of other things to do!”

lines.japanese: 墜ちて墜ちて、ついにイーグルが私の高度に並んだ。
lines.english: Down and down he fell, until at last Eagle reached my altitude.

lines.japanese: 私はガルーダロッドに蒼い火を灯すと、上段に構えて最大戦速で突きすすんだ。
lines.english: I kindled blue flame upon the Garuda Rod, raised it high, and charged at maximum battle speed.

lines.japanese: 「腑抜けた元勇者め、惰眠の酬いを受けるがよい！」
lines.english: “Spineless former hero! Reap now the wages of your indolence!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、待って、やっぱごめん、ブランクきついっす！　ハンデちょうだいハンデ！」
lines.english: “Wait, hold on! I'm sorry, okay? This much rust is brutal! Give me a handicap!”

lines.japanese: 「往生際の悪い。この期に及んでまだ剣を抜かぬか！」
lines.english: “You cling disgracefully to life. Even now, you will not draw your sword?”

lines.japanese: 後ずさりながら射かけてくる矢を叩きおとす。
lines.english: I struck down the arrows he fired as he retreated.

lines.japanese: ガルーダロッドの燃えさかる杖頭は、立ちのぼる霊気に比例して、漸次その質量を増してくる。
lines.english: The blazing head of the Garuda Rod grew steadily in mass, in proportion to the spiritual force pouring from it.

lines.japanese: 「えええ何その武器！　なんかどんどん大きくなってません！？」
lines.english: “What is that weapon!? Is it just me, or is it getting bigger and bigger!?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃあ『ようじゅつしのつえ』は『どうぐ』で使うと１ターンごとにこうげき力あがってくかんねー」
lines.english: “Well, yeah. When you use the Sorcerer's Staff as an item, its attack power goes up every turn.”

lines.japanese: 「ようじゅつし、意外に肉弾系！？」
lines.english: “Sorcerers are surprisingly physical!?”

lines.japanese: 「否、万能家だッ！」
lines.english: “Nay! We are masters of every art!”

lines.japanese: 近接戦の間合いに届いた。私は速度を落とさぬまま一気に飛びこむや、鉄槌と化した愛杖を目標の脳天めがけ振りおろした。
lines.english: I reached striking range. Without slowing, I plunged forward and brought my beloved staff—now an iron hammer—down upon my target's skull.

lines.japanese: 「おおっとォ！」
lines.english: “Whoops!”

lines.japanese: 敵は舞うように華々しく身をひるがえす。とぼけた泣き言を漏らしてはいても、いまだ体さばきにけれん味を加えられるだけの余裕はあるようだ。
lines.english: The enemy wheeled aside in a flamboyant, almost dancing turn. For all his foolish whimpering, he plainly retained enough composure to embellish his movements with theatrical flair.

lines.japanese: 「ばふん、外したか」
lines.english: “Bah. I missed.”

lines.japanese: 「うそォーん！？　地面えぐれてんすけどォー！」
lines.english: “No waaay! You put a crater in the ground!”

lines.japanese: 「気高き王宮の面汚しが。いまだ逃げ足だけは一人前のようだな、道化」
lines.english: “Disgrace to the noble court. It seems flight alone remains a skill worthy of the name, jester.”

lines.japanese: 「お、お誉めにあずかり光栄です、ええと、なんてお呼びしたらよかったかしら。陛下？　ガルーダ様？　伽楼羅くん？」
lines.english: “A-an honor to receive your praise. Now, what was I supposed to call you? Your Majesty? Lord Garuda? Little Karura?”

lines.japanese: 「死にゆく下郎に教えても無駄なこと。伽楼羅でもガルーダでもヘンリーでもナンシーでも正夫でも鶴吉でも好きに呼ぶがよいわ。どのみち貴様はここで朽ちはてるのだからな！」
lines.english: “It is wasted breath to instruct one marked for death. Karura, Garuda, Henry, Nancy, Masao, Tsurukichi—call me whatever you wish. You shall rot here regardless!”

lines.japanese: 「ぬうん！」
lines.english: “Nnngh!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃーっ！」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: 「どりゃは！」
lines.english: “Doryah!”

lines.japanese: 「いやーっ！」
lines.english: “Nooo!”

lines.japanese: 「ウヴァアアアー！」
lines.english: “Uvaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「らめえーっ！」
lines.english: “Staaahp!”

lines.japanese: 「ええい、女々しく這いまわる油虫めが。そこに直れ、これ以上王家の誇りを汚すな！」
lines.english: “Enough! You sniveling cockroach, forever scuttling out of reach. Stand before me and cease disgracing the royal house!”

lines.japanese: 「た、たたた助けてヨージ君！」
lines.english: “H-h-h-help me, Yoji!”

lines.japanese: 尻餅ついたまま逃げまどうイーグルは、ついに恥も外聞も武器さえもかなぐり捨てて、幼き先代国王に泣きすがった。
lines.english: Still scrambling away on his backside, Eagle finally cast aside dignity, appearances, and even his weapon, and clung weeping to the child who had once been king.

lines.japanese: 「ええーっ？　なんだよおまい、カッチョわりいなあ、さいしょスゲエかっちょよく出てきたのに」
lines.english: “What? Come on, you look pathetic. You made such an awesome entrance, too.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、あの……だって昔みたいに、もっとこう、レクリエーション感覚でワイワイやるもんかと思ってたもんで。こんな、ガチで魂削りあうなんて知ってたら来てないっすよ、こんなとこ」
lines.english: “Well, uh... I figured it'd be more like the old days, you know? Everybody horsing around, having fun, like recreation. If I'd known we'd be seriously grinding away at each other's souls, I never would've come to a place like this.”

lines.japanese: 「そっかー。でも、わりいなあ。おれも助けてやりたいんだけど、そしたら今度かるらが負けちゃうしなあ」
lines.english: “Oh. Sorry. I wanna help you, but then Karura would lose instead.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、ヨージ君そんなに強いの」
lines.english: “Wait, Yoji, are you really that strong?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃ兄ちゃんだもん、いっちゃん強えーよ。お兄ちゃんパワーを使えば、たいてーのことはできんだぞ」
lines.english: “Course I am. I'm the big brother, so I'm the strongest. Big Brother Power can do almost anything.”

lines.japanese: 「たしかに名前からして無茶苦茶そう！」
lines.english: “The name alone sounds outrageously overpowered!”

lines.japanese: 「見苦しいぞ、久遠の翼」
lines.english: “You shame yourself, Eternal Wing.”

lines.japanese: 私は蒼き炎の燃えさかる杖頭を脇にはさみ、先端の石突を敵の鼻先へ突きつけた。
lines.english: I tucked the head of my blue-flaming staff beneath my arm and thrust its iron-shod tip beneath the enemy's nose.

lines.japanese: 「立て、惰弱な精神。男らしく殴り合いを始めようぞ。ぬんっ！」
lines.english: “Rise, feeble spirit. Let us commence a manly exchange of blows. Nngh!”

lines.japanese: 「のわあーッ、待って待って、まだ立ってませえーん！」
lines.english: “Waaah! Wait, wait, I'm not even standing yet!”

lines.japanese: しかしふたたび武器をふるったとき──
lines.english: But when next I swung my weapon—
“Guh!”

lines.japanese: ──吹きとばされていたのは私の方だった。
lines.english: —I was the one sent flying.

lines.japanese: 「ぼヴぇあブひバん！」
lines.english: “Boveah-buh-bahn!”

lines.japanese: 夜襲のごとき不意の一撃を喰らって、私はもんどり打って転げまわった。
lines.english: Struck by a blow as sudden as a night raid, I pitched head over heels across the ground.
“Huh? Wh-what...?”

lines.japanese: 「毎度」
lines.english: “At your service.”

lines.japanese: 腹這いの姿勢から睨みあげると、イーグルの前に引きこもりファルコンが立ちふさがっていた。
lines.english: Glaring up from where I lay sprawled, I found the reclusive Falcon standing between Eagle and me.

lines.japanese: 「あなたの街の便利屋さん、成田工務店おれ支店です」
lines.english: “Narita Construction, your friendly neighborhood handyman—one-man branch.”

lines.japanese: 「なにを……」
lines.english: “What have you...”

lines.japanese: 私は杖をたのみに立ちあがる。いちど思考の糸を切られたせいで蒼い炎はくすぶりはてていた。
lines.english: I used my staff to haul myself upright. With my train of thought broken, the blue flame had guttered almost entirely away.

lines.japanese: 「ななな何をするか貴様！　夜の街のドブネズミが！」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-what have you done, gutter rat of the night!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だって、殴り合い始めるとか言ってッから。俺の出番かと思うじゃんフツー」
lines.english: “What? You said you wanted to start trading punches. Figured that was my cue. Anybody would.”

lines.japanese: 「おー、ファルコン！　よかったあ、おまい、あのへやから出てきたんだな」
lines.english: “Hey, Falcon! You finally came outta that room!”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、ヨージか。はん、おまえの方こそ、長年引きこもってたくせして──」
lines.english: “Oh, Yoji. Hah. You're one to talk, after shutting yourself away for years—”

lines.japanese: 「うわぁ、ちょっと待って……俺、隼人君に助けられちゃったわけ？　しかも消えかけ状態の？　うえぇー、何ソレ一生の不覚じゃん……」
lines.english: Whoa, wait... Did I seriously get saved by Hayato? And while he was already halfway gone? Ugh, what is that? A disgrace I'll carry for life...

lines.japanese: 「あ？　んだコラ、この糞ワシ。てめ、素直にありがとうございましたって土下座できねーのかよ。そーゆうチンケな見栄張ってッから、いまそのザマなんだろが」
lines.english: “Huh? The hell'd you say, you shitbird? Can't you get on your knees and say thank you like a decent person? This petty pride of yours is how you ended up in this mess.”

lines.japanese: 「なーにを。キミねえ、素直じゃないのはどっちよ。どう考えたって、あの自分バンザイ他人ファッキューでおなじみの成田隼人君が、善意オンリーで人助けなんてするはずないっしょ」
lines.english: “Oh, please. Which one of us isn't being honest? Everybody knows Hayato Narita—Mr. Hail Me, Fuck Everybody Else—doesn't rescue people out of the pure goodness of his heart.”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ、ばかおまえ、違げーよ。こう見えて俺は意外と、弱きを助け強きを挫きたいお年頃なんだよ」
lines.english: “Y-you idiot, that's not it. Believe it or not, I'm at that age where a guy wants to defend the weak and knock the strong down a peg.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃないでしょ？　ちがくて本当は、みんなでワイワイ騒いでンのが楽しそうだから、一緒に遊びたくなって出てきちゃっただけでしょ？　ハアまったくキミはもー、天岩戸のアマテラスかっての」
lines.english: “That's not it, is it? No, what really happened was, everybody looked like they were having so much fun that you wanted to come out and play too, right? Haaah, honestly, you... What are you, Amaterasu coming out of her cave?”

lines.japanese: 「ありー？　なんだ、もうケンカかあ？　おまいら、ほーんと、どいつもこいつも仲わるいなあ」
lines.english: “Huh? What, you're fighting already? Every last one of you really does hate everybody else.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なんだこの糞ガキ。おいてめコラ、どの口が言ったんだ、あァ？」
lines.english: “Huh? What's that, you little shit? Which mouth said that? This one? Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶみぃ！　ひででで……いでぇーよ、はなせよーう」
lines.english: “Bweee! Ow ow ow... That hurts! Let go!”

lines.japanese: 「ああもう、やめなさいって。子供いじめるために出てきたのかよ、キミは……ほら、もう、ガルーダのひとだって呆れちゃって言葉も──」
lines.english: “Ohhh, come on, stop it. Did you come out just to bully a child? Look, now even Garuda's too appalled for words—”

lines.japanese: 「──ん？　あ、あれ？　ガルーダの彼は？」
lines.english: “—hm? Wait. Where did Garuda go?”
“Right here!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶふっ」
lines.english: “Bgh!”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君！」
lines.english: “Hayato!”

lines.japanese: 戦にあって戦を忘れるとは愚の骨頂。雑話にふける彼らの目を盗めば、妖術師たる私には、敵の虚を衝くすべなどいくらでもあるのだ。
lines.english: To forget the battle while standing upon the field is the summit of folly. While they lost themselves in idle chatter, a sorcerer such as I had any number of means to exploit the enemy's opening.

lines.japanese: 「うぉんむうぉんむ、一撃返したぞスラムの王。闇に乗じた奇襲ならばこちらに一日の長があること、ゆめゆめ忘れるなかれ」
lines.english: “Hrrm, hrrm. I have repaid your blow, king of the slums. Never forget that in ambush under cover of darkness, I hold the advantage of long experience.”

lines.japanese: 「つゥ、あーてて……いってえーなチクショてめ。んーだソレ、棒はナシだろ棒は、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Ngh... Ah, damn, that hurts. The hell was that, asshole? A stick's cheating. You can't use a goddamn stick! I'll fucking kill you, asshole!”

lines.japanese: すでに王族としての誇りを捨てている愚弟ファルコンは、受けた痛みを隠しもせず子供のようにうめく。私は杖の先端を敵の鼻に向けた。
lines.english: Falcon, my foolish brother who had already discarded his royal dignity, moaned like a child without the slightest attempt to hide his pain. I pointed the end of my staff at his nose.

lines.japanese: 「続けるのかファルコン。だがイーグルは、貴様の助力など欲しておらぬようだが？」
lines.english: “Will you continue, Falcon? Eagle, however, appears not to desire your assistance.”

lines.japanese: 「あーいやいや、欲してはいるっす。嫌がってるだけで協力はしてほしいんす」
lines.english: “Oh, no, no, I do desire it. I just don't like it. I still want the help.”

lines.japanese: 「おうよ、俺だって協力はしてやるけど、ほんとは嫌で嫌でしょーがねえんだよ」
lines.english: “Yeah. And I'll help, but I hate every goddamn second of it.”

lines.japanese: 「なー、おまいら、仲いいのか悪いのかどっちなん？」
lines.english: “Hey, do you guys get along or not?”

lines.japanese: 「悪りーよ。悪りーに決まってンだろ。でも俺ァ、あいつ──あのイカれた覗き見野郎だけは、糞ワシ以上に好かねえンだ」
lines.english: “No. Course we don't. But that freak—that psycho peeping bastard—I hate him even more than this shitbird.”

lines.japanese: にわかにファルコンが闘気を拡散させた。白けた表情の中、敵意の眼光が静かにともる。
lines.english: Falcon's fighting spirit abruptly spread around him. Beneath his sullen expression, the light of hostility quietly kindled in his eyes.

lines.japanese: 「こちとら、どうせ消える身だ、てめえを地獄への道連れにしてやるよ」
lines.english: “I'm gonna disappear anyway. Might as well drag you down to hell with me.”

lines.japanese: 「もひゃふはふは！　余に地獄を語るとは笑止。貴様がごとき陽の下ですら生きられなかった若造など、奈落の名に懸けて、我が暗黒の敵ではないわ！」
lines.english: “Mohyafuhaha! You speak to me of hell? Absurd! A whelp who could not endure life even beneath the sun is no match for my darkness—I swear it by the Abyss!”

lines.japanese: 「でもよー、かるら。いっくらおまいでも、やっぱ２対１はきついだろー」
lines.english: “But Karura, even for you, two against one has gotta be tough.”

lines.japanese: 「るふう、取るに足りませんな。息の合わぬ者同士が組んだところで、かえって足を引っ張りあう──」
lines.english: “Rufuh. They are beneath concern. Let two men who cannot act in harmony join forces, and they shall merely hinder one another—”

lines.japanese: 「隼人君、前衛後衛に分かれよう。俺が下がって急所を狙撃するから、キミは前に出て足止めをして」
lines.english: “Hayato, we'll split into front and rear. I'll hang back and snipe his weak points. You get in close and pin him down.”

lines.japanese: 「鷲介、前衛後衛に分かれンぞ。俺が前に出てやつを足止めすッから、おまえ裏からバンバン撃て」
lines.english: “Shusuke, we're splitting front and rear. I'll get up front and hold him. You stay back and keep shooting.”

lines.japanese: 「ありり……あいつら、仲わるいのに息はぴったりだな」
lines.english: “Huh... They hate each other, but they're perfectly in sync.”

lines.japanese: 短弓を取りもどしたイーグルがたちまち遠ざかってゆく。立ちふさがるファルコンの両手にもそれぞれ、玩具じみた短刀が現れた。
lines.english: Having recovered his shortbow, Eagle swiftly opened the distance. Toylike daggers appeared in each of Falcon's hands as he barred my path.

lines.japanese: 「ふぬん……ファルコンの武器は銀のダガーか」
lines.english: “Hrm... Falcon wields silver daggers.”

lines.japanese: 「しょぼっ！　なにそれ隼人君、もっとマシな武器出してよ！」
lines.english: “Pathetic! What's with those, Hayato? Conjure something better!”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、ガキの頃やったゲームなんてほとんど覚えてねーよ。いいや面倒くせえ」
lines.english: “Shut up. I barely remember some game I played as a kid. Ah, screw this.”

lines.japanese: 卑しきスラムの王はふたつの武器を放りすて、鋭い視線の先にこぶしを構えた。
lines.english: The base king of the slums cast both weapons aside and raised his fists toward me, his gaze sharp.

lines.japanese: 「おう。やっぱこっちのがしっくり来るわ」
lines.english: “Yeah. This feels more natural.”

lines.japanese: 「たわけが、武具は男の魂ぞ。末流とはいえグレタガルド王家の血が流るる身で、なんたる蛮行か！　恥を知れ、俗人ーッ！」
lines.english: “Fool! A man's arms are his very soul! Though yours is but a cadet branch, the blood of Gretagard's royal house flows through you. What barbarism! Shame upon you, commoner!”

lines.japanese: 「っとオ」
lines.english: “Whoop.”

lines.japanese: 私は自らを鋼の矢に変じて突進したが、敵はけもののような俊敏さで身をかわした。
lines.english: I transformed myself into an arrow of steel and charged, but the enemy slipped aside with the agility of a beast.

lines.japanese: 瞬間、埋めこまれる衝撃。
lines.english: An impact drove into me that same instant.

lines.japanese: 「おら！」
lines.english: “Take that!”

lines.japanese: 「ぐっ」
lines.english: “Guh!”

lines.japanese: 「おらおら！」
lines.english: “And that!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶ、ぶパッ……」
lines.english: “B-bwah...”

lines.japanese: 「シッ！　シ、シッ！」
lines.english: “Hss! Hss, hss!”

lines.japanese: 「へぶ！　グッ、げえぇ……！」
lines.english: “Hngh! Guh—gaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「ハイ捕まえたァ、ハイ素手最強ォ」
lines.english: “Gotcha. Bare hands win again.”

lines.japanese: 「くっ！　ぶぬぬ、非常識な蛮人め！　たかが没落王族の分際で余に触れるとは無礼であろう。放せ、放さんか！」
lines.english: “Ngh! You savage, ignorant of all civilized law! For a mere scion of a fallen royal house to lay hands upon me is insolence beyond measure. Release me! I command you, release me!”

lines.japanese: 「っしゃあ、鷲介。ブスッと二、三発いけ。いまのうち、俺ごとブチ抜いとけ！」
lines.english: “All right, Shusuke. Put two or three straight through him. While you've got the shot, punch 'em through me too!”

lines.japanese: 「わお！　それは熱い、熱いよ隼人君。ん～、でも分かる、この展開は童心に返っちゃうよねえ」
lines.english: “Wow! Now that's what I call hot-blooded, Hayato. Mm, I get it, though—stuff like this really brings out the kid in you, huh?”

lines.japanese: 彼方の間を隔てて、イーグルが鷹揚な所作で弓矢を構える。皮肉にもそれは、グレタガルド王家の名にふさわしい流れるような優雅さだった。
lines.english: Across the intervening distance, Eagle raised his bow with easy grandeur. Ironically, the motion possessed a flowing elegance worthy of Gretagard's royal house.

lines.japanese: 「照準合わせＯＫ、エネルギー充填１２０％！　なんちゃって？」
lines.english: “Target locked. Energy charge: one hundred twenty percent! Or something?”

lines.japanese: 弓弦を引きしぼりながら、愚弟が片目で笑う。
lines.english: As he drew the string taut, my foolish brother winked.

lines.japanese: 「必殺！　アレックスシュート！」
lines.english: “Special attack! Alex Shoot!”

lines.japanese: 「プラスおまけだ、セカン！　サード！　フォース！」
lines.english: “And a little extra—second! Third! Fourth!”

lines.japanese: まばゆい閃光が四条、遮るものもない空を裂いて迫る。だがファルコンの束縛は固い。触媒を封じられては強力な術が行使できない。
lines.english: Four dazzling streaks tore across the unobstructed sky toward us. But Falcon held me fast. With my reagents pinned, I could employ no powerful sorcery.

lines.japanese: 「う、ウヴァアアアーッ！」
lines.english: “U-uvaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 忌まわしき奈落の闇が脳裏をよぎったそのとき──
lines.english: And just as the hateful darkness of the Abyss crossed my mind—

lines.japanese: 「世界が！　平和で！　あります！　ように！」
lines.english: “*May! Peace! Prevail! On Earth!*”

lines.japanese: ──黄金の風とも見紛うべき、神速の斬撃が四たび。
lines.english: —four godswift slashes flashed like a golden wind.

lines.japanese: 「げっ！」
lines.english: “Gah!”

lines.japanese: イーグルの矢はことごとく叩きおとされていた。
lines.english: Every one of Eagle's arrows had been struck from the air.

lines.japanese: 「聖騎士ホーク・シアンブルー、推参！」
lines.english: “Holy Knight Hawk Cyan-Blue, reporting for battle!”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ、ごっこ遊びの現役来ちゃったァー！」
lines.english: “Oh, great! The one guy still actively playing make-believe is here!”

lines.japanese: 「つか、自分で聖騎士とか名乗るかフツー？」
lines.english: “Who goes around calling himself a holy knight, anyway?”

lines.japanese: 「おー、ホーク！　おまえも遊びに来たのかあ」
lines.english: “Hey, Hawk! Did you come over to play too?”

lines.japanese: 「ご壮健でなによりです、コンドル前王陛下。そして、どうしたんだみんな、“万色の四枚羽根”久々の再会が内輪もめとは情けないぞ」
lines.english: “I am pleased to find you well, former King Condor. But what has come over the rest of you? The Four Wings of Many Colors meet again after so long, only to quarrel among themselves. It is shameful.”

lines.japanese: 「だまれ黄金の鷹。余計な真似をしてくれたな。貴様に情けをかけられるぐらいなら、このガルーダ、奈落の底で眠っておった方がましだ！　あ、いや、ふむぅん、でも奈落には戻りたくないなあ」
lines.english: “Silence, Golden Hawk. Your interference was needless. Garuda would sooner have slept at the bottom of the Abyss than accept your pity! Ah—no. Hrm. I do not particularly wish to return to the Abyss.”

lines.japanese: 「よえー」
lines.english: “Weak.”

lines.japanese: 「こらー！　もー、そんなこと言うなてー、かるらはかあいそーな子なんだからぁー！」
lines.english: “Hey! Don't say that. Karura's had it really hard!”

lines.japanese: 「ともあれ二対一での決闘など、騎士の典範にも私の流儀にももとる。ガルーダ、そなたは気に召さぬかもしれんが、どうかこの聖騎士ホークに助太刀をさせてくれ」
lines.english: “In any event, a duel fought two against one violates both the knightly code and my own principles. Garuda, it may displease you, but pray allow this Holy Knight Hawk to stand at your side.”

lines.japanese: 「やったやった、これで全員さんかだあ！」
lines.english: “Yay! Now everybody's playing!”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ！　ちょっと、自重してよタカシ君。キミソレね、おっちゃんだらけのＯＢ草野球に、現役プロ選手が割りこんでくるようなもんだからね。そっちのがよっぽど大人げないってもんよ」
lines.english: “What!? Show a little restraint, Takashi. This is like an active professional barging into an old-timers' sandlot baseball game. If anyone's being childish here, it's you.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、だな。やんならせめて現役とＯＢ散らそうぜ。もう俺、この糞ワシと組むの嫌だし」
lines.english: “Yeah, he's right. At least spread the active players and alumni between the teams. I'm already sick of teaming up with this shitbird.”

lines.japanese: 「おーし、わかった。そんじゃあ、仲良くケンカしねーように、グーパーでチーム分けすんぞー」
lines.english: “All right, got it. Then we'll split into teams by fists and palms so we can all fight nice together.”

lines.japanese: 「てかコレ、ケンカじゃなかったの」
lines.english: “Wait, wasn't this already a fight?”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、大事なのは勝敗じゃないぞイーグル。真剣勝負を通じていかに自分を高められるかだ」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Winning and losing are not what matter, Eagle. What matters is how much you better yourself through earnest competition.”

lines.japanese: 「しかも、なんか、スポーツ哲学みたいな話に発展してんぞ……」
lines.english: “And now it's somehow turned into sports philosophy...”

lines.japanese: 「おーい、ほらみんな手ぇだせー。いくぞー、せーのぉ、♪出さなきゃだめよー……」
lines.english: “Hands out, everybody! Here we go—ready, and... ♪ You’ve gotta show your ha-a-and...”

lines.japanese: 「必殺、グレタカリ・バーニング！　でやあああー！」
lines.english: “Special attack—Gretacali Burning! Deyaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「どわあーっ！　参った参った、降参降参！」
lines.english: “Waaah! I yield! I yield! I surrender!”

lines.japanese: 「たわけが！　勝敗を決するは敗者の意にあらず、その命の灯火にのみあらん！」
lines.english: “Fool! Victory is not the loser's to declare. Only the snuffing of his life's flame shall decide it!”

lines.japanese: 「あでっ……ちょ、ちょ、落ちつけって！　痛ぇ痛ぇ痛ぇ！」
lines.english: “Ow! H-hold on, calm down! It hurts, it hurts, it hurts!”

lines.japanese: 「きゃはは、いいぞやれやれー！」
lines.english: “Ahaha! That's it! Get 'em!”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、はあ……流石だな、やるじゃないか、みんな……」
lines.english: “Hah, hah... Impressive. You all fight well...”

lines.japanese: 「ぼふん、ぼふん……まったくだ、下郎にしては根性のある……」
lines.english: “Bofun, bofun... Indeed. For lowborn wretches, you possess admirable spirit...”

lines.japanese: 「てゆーか……ぜえ、ぜえ……よく考えたらコレ、決着つかないでしょ永遠に……」
lines.english: “I mean... hah, hah... come to think of it, this can never actually end, can it...?”

lines.japanese: 「ふゥ、ふゥ……そーいや俺ら、いまカラダねえもんな……キモチ的に疲れても体力は底なしだわ……」
lines.english: “Huff, huff... Yeah, we don't have bodies right now... We might feel tired, but our stamina's bottomless...”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、１３回戦めも引きわけかー……あい次、１４回戦めのチーム決めんぞー、ふぁ～あ……」
lines.english: “Hmm, round thirteen's another draw... Okay, time to pick teams for round fourteen... Yaaawn...”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、はあ……２７回戦めも決着つかずか……」
lines.english: Hah, hah... Still no winner after round twenty-seven, huh...?

lines.japanese: 「ぼふん、ぼふん……ええい、引き際を知らぬ田舎貴族どもめ……」
lines.english: “Bofun, bofun... Damn you rustic nobles, ignorant of when to withdraw...”

lines.japanese: 「てゆか……ぜえ、ぜえ……旗取ったら勝ちとか、缶蹴ったら終わりとか、最初に勝利条件みたいなの決めとこうよ……」
lines.english: “I mean... hah, hah... next time, let's decide on a victory condition first. Capture the flag, kick the can, something like that...”

lines.japanese: 「ふゥ、ふゥ……ちょっと待て……ソレいよいよケンカから離れてくぞ」
lines.english: “Huff, huff... Hold up... That's getting awfully far away from a fight.”

lines.japanese: 「はふぅ～……なーんかちょっと、あきてきちったな……むにゃむにゃ」
lines.english: “Haaah... I'm kinda getting bored now... Mmnn.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、はあ……みんな、ちょっと提案があるんだ、聞いてくれ……すでに君たちは戦いつかれ、随分と士気も下がっているようだ」
lines.english: “Hah, hah... Everyone, I have a proposal. Hear me out... You are clearly exhausted from battle, and your morale has fallen considerably.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、オメーもだろ……何が君たちはだ、いらん見栄張んな……」
lines.english: “You're exhausted too... Quit saying *you* and putting on airs...”

lines.japanese: 「いいよいいよ、休憩でしょ……さんせー……ってかもう解散でもいんすけど……」
lines.english: “Fine, fine, you want a break... I vote yes... Hell, I'd be fine calling the whole thing off...”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ……逃がさんぞイーグル、そうして貴様ひとりまた栄光の玉座へ戻る気だろう……」
lines.english: “What... I shall not let you escape, Eagle. You intend to return alone to the glorious throne once more...”

lines.japanese: 「いやまあ……そりゃあねえ……誰かが≪コックピット≫戻んなきゃならないわけだし……？」
lines.english: “Well... yes... Somebody has to go back to the *Cockpit*, doesn't he...?”

lines.japanese: 「おのれ、いけしゃあしゃあと！　許さんぞ、立てッ！　ただちに４４回戦目を始めるのだ！」
lines.english: “You shameless knave! I shall not permit it. Rise! We begin round forty-four at once!”

lines.japanese: 「おまいら、まだやってんのお？　んもー、ちっとは仲よくしたらいいのに、ふぁ～あ……ああ、困ったなあ、困ったから夢テレビでも見てえなあ……むにゃむにゃ」
lines.english: “You're still going? Come on, try getting along for once... Yaaawn... Oh, what a mess. Since it's a mess, I wanna watch Dream TV... Mmnn.”

lines.japanese: 「ＪＯ俺Ｘ－ＴＶ、ＪＯ俺Ｘ－ＴＶ」
lines.english: “JO-ORE-X TV. JO-ORE-X TV.”

lines.japanese: 「こちらは７兆チャンネル、ＡＣＴ奈落中央テレビです」
lines.english: “This is Channel Seven Trillion, ACT Central Abyss Television.”

lines.japanese: 「おかけになった番組は、ただいまお客さまが電波の届かない場所にいるか、本体が死んでいるため映りません」
lines.english: “The program you have dialed is currently unavailable because the viewer is outside our broadcast area or the receiving unit is dead.”

lines.japanese: 「おかけになった番組は、ただいまお客様が──」
lines.english: “The program you have dialed is currently unavailable because the viewer—”

lines.japanese: 「あーそっかー、ここ夢テレビ入んねーんだあ。したら夢ラジオもむりかなあ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Dream TV doesn't come in here. Guess Dream Radio won't work either.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃあ無理さ。なにしろコンドル忙しいからね。相手してあげられるのは、生きるのに疲れちゃったラビリンスの子羊ちゃんたち限定なんだ」
lines.english: No can do. Condor's a busy guy, after all. The only people I can make time for are the little lambs of the Labyrinth who've gotten tired of living.

lines.japanese: 「はー、そーなん」
lines.english: “Huh. That so?”

lines.japanese: 「ＲＮ一番目クン、君はもう奈落に戻ってこないのかい？」
lines.english: “Radio Name Number One, are you not coming back to the Abyss?”

lines.japanese: 「んー、わかんない。だってさだってさ、上のせかいも、さいきんは意外とおもっしぇーみたいでさ。まあ、夢テレビとかもおもっしぇーんだけど、やっぱ本モンのほうが──」
lines.english: “Hmm. Dunno. See, lately the world up there sounds kinda fun too. Dream TV and stuff is fun, sure, but the real thing's still—”

lines.japanese: 「──ありっ？　コンドルさん、なんでここにいんの？　ここ、ならくじゃないし、あとこないだズガズガうたれて死んぢったじゃん」
lines.english: “—huh? Condor, what're you doing here? This isn't the Abyss. And didn't you get shot a whole bunch and die the other day?”

lines.japanese: 「ノーノー、ドントスピーク。そんなのは気にするほどのこっちゃないんだ。ええまあ厳密にいえばね、たしかに死後十数時間が経過して、ただいま絶賛死亡中のコンドルなわけだけれどハ～イ、コンドルワ～」
lines.english: No, no, don't speak. That's nothing worth worrying about. Well, strictly speaking, sure, it's been over ten hours since I died and Condor is currently very much dead, but heeey! Condorvening!

lines.japanese: 「まあいいですよ、そっちがそんなこと言っちゃうんだったらね、あの、コンドルだって言わせてもらっちゃいますけどね。あの、ＲＮ一番目クン君ねあの、本当はもう子供じゃないんだから。何ちゃっかり忘れてんの」
lines.english: Well, fine. If you're gonna talk like that, then Condor's gonna say his piece too. Radio Name Number One, my boy, you're not really a kid anymore. How'd you just conveniently forget that?

lines.japanese: 「あっ、そっか……」
lines.english: “Oh, right...”

lines.japanese: 「うえっ！？　あー、やっばー、思いだしたら大人にもどっちったよ。もーなんだよコンドルさん、おれずっと子供がよかったのに……」
lines.english: “Whoa!? Oh, crap! Soon as I remembered, I turned back into a grown-up. Come on, Condor! I wanted to stay a kid forever...”

lines.japanese: 「まァまァ気持ちは分かるんですけどね、ええコンドルとて基本、ファッキン大人ワナビー子供っていうスタンスでこの番組やってますから、ま分かるんですけど、あのー、夢と現実っていうのがね、ありますからね」
lines.english: “Now, now, I know how you feel. Condor himself hosts this show as a fucking grown-up who’d rather be a kid, so believe me, I know. But, well, there’s this little matter of dreams and reality.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶっちゃけた話、子供のまま奈落出ちゃったらあの、いろいろ問題ありますんで。ええ、ここはひとつスパッと男らしく諦めていただいてね。ええ、ツル植物のようにグングン育っていただいてね」
lines.english: “Frankly, leaving the Abyss while still a child would cause all kinds of problems. So this is where you give it up cleanly, like a man, and grow like a climbing vine.”

lines.japanese: 「そっかー。うーん、じゃあポッポに会いたいから、ほんとはヤだけどしょーがないから育ってやるよ」
lines.english: “Oh. Well, I wanna see Poppo, so I don't really wanna, but I guess I'll grow up if I have to.”

lines.japanese: 「オーケイ、よく言ったＲＮ一番目クン！　これは勇気ある最初の一歩だ、アームストロング船長ばりの一歩だ、地球もまたげる大きな一歩だァ！」
lines.english: “Okay! Well said, Radio Name Number One! A courageous first step, a step worthy of Captain Armstrong, one giant enough to straddle the Earth!”

lines.japanese: 「あ。でもさー、おれとかガルーダとか、みんないなくなっちったら、ならくのコンドルさんたちどーなんの？」
lines.english: “Oh. But if me and Garuda and everybody disappear, what happens to you and the others in the Abyss?”

lines.japanese: 「おいおいおい、言ったろう母なるベイベェ、そんなのは気にすることじゃないんだよ。気にせず進め、踏みこえろ死体、キンナケン・カルマチ」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, hey. I told you, Mother Baby, that isn't yours to worry about. March on without concern. Step across the corpses. Kinnaken Karmachi.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、ひとりだけなんだって。表のせかいには、ひとりしか上がれないんだって」
lines.english: “But they said only one. Only one person can go back up to the surface.”

lines.japanese: 「おれ、またポッポに会いたいんだけど、でも他のみんなとケンカすんのはヤだなあ。コンドルさん、おれ、どうしたらいいと思うー？」
lines.english: “I wanna see Poppo again, but I don't wanna fight everybody else. Condor, what do you think I should do?”

lines.japanese: 「ン～、なるほどなるほど、これはいい質問をありがとーうＲＮ一番目クン！」
lines.english: “Mmm, I see, I see! Thank you for that excellent question, Radio Name Number One!”

lines.japanese: 「えー、というわけでね、えー要は、みんなで飛行機乗りたいけどチケットが一枚しかないっていうね、言うなればそういう偽善貪欲ナンバーワンなご質問なわけですけれど」
lines.english: Sooo, anyway, basically, everybody wants to get on the plane, but there's only one ticket. In other words, this is the number-one question in hypocritical greed.

lines.japanese: 「ま、コレもう答えは出てますよね。ええもう、はみ出ちゃってますよね。そりゃ簡単です、いいですか。みんな行きたいけどチケットが一枚、そんなときはですね、みんなくっついて一人になっちゃってくだサ～イ」
lines.english: “But the answer's already out, isn't it? Practically sticking right out. Simple as can be. Ready? Everybody wants to go, but there's only one ticket. When that happens, all of you stick together and become one persooon!”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、おれもソレさっき考えたんだけどさー。できんのかな、ほんとに」
lines.english: “Hmm. I thought of that earlier too. But can we really do it?”

lines.japanese: 「オーケイ、それじゃあ基本に立ちかえって考えてみよう。そもそもＲＮ一番目クン、なぜ君は、他の子たちを作ったんだったかな？」
lines.english: “Okay. Then let's return to first principles. Radio Name Number One, why did you create the other children in the first place?”

lines.japanese: 「んー？　なんでだっけ、うんとねえ、そうだ、ポッポのためだ」
lines.english: “Hmm? Why was it? Let's see... Oh, right. For Poppo.”

lines.japanese: 「おれ、あのころ表のせかいヤんなっちゃって、ならく行きたかったんだけど、そしたらポッポが一人んなっちゃうでしょー。それはかあいそーだから、おれの代わりにだれか置いてこうと思ったの」
lines.english: “Back then I got sick of the world up top, and I wanted to go to the Abyss. But then Poppo would've been all alone, right? That'd be sad, so I thought I'd leave somebody else in my place.”

lines.japanese: 「だっておれじゃなくても、そいつがおれより強えーかったり、おれより頭いいーかったりしたら、ポッポもおれなんかより気に入るはずじゃんか」
lines.english: “Even if it wasn't me, if that guy was strong-er than me or smart-er than me, Poppo was bound to like him better anyway.”

lines.japanese: 「さあて、そいつはどうだろう。たしかに伽楼羅クンや隼人クンは、君よりも強いだろう。鷹志クンや鷲介クンは、君より頭がいいかもしれない」
lines.english: “Now, I'm not so sure. Karura and Hayato may indeed be stronger than you. Takashi and Shusuke may be cleverer than you.”

lines.japanese: 「だが一つだけ確かなことがある。鷹志クン、君の妹さんはね、他の誰でもなく、ただひとり君さえいれば幸せだったんだよ！　だったんだよ！　だったんだよ！」
lines.english: “But one thing alone is certain. Takashi, your little sister needed no one else. She would have been happy simply to have you, her one and only brother, beside her! Beside her! Beside her!”

lines.japanese: 「はー、そーなん」
lines.english: “Huh. That so?”

lines.japanese: 「こいつァ悲しい皮肉だ。兄は妹を幸せにしたくてより優れた他人を作りだしたってぇのに、妹にとっての幸せとはただひとり本当の兄がそばにいることだったのさ。ドァギンコン・キェルーメッシ」
lines.english: “What bitter irony! The brother created people better than himself to make his sister happy, only to learn that all she wanted was her one true brother beside her. Doagincon Kyerumessi.”

lines.japanese: 「そっかー。そうだいねー。じゃあ、やっぱ、もどんないとねー」
lines.english: “Oh. Yeah, I guess so. Then I really do gotta go back.”

lines.japanese: 「ザッツライ、よく言ったパートⅡ。君にその気があるなら何でもできる。なぜならここは君の世界、君が宇宙の創造主、君の気分ですべてが決まる。やるもやらぬも君次第。生きるも死ぬも気持ち次第」
lines.english: “That's right! Well said, Part Two! If you've got the will, you can do anything. This is your world. You are the creator of the cosmos, and everything is decided by how you feel. Do it or don't—it's up to you. Live or die—it's up to how you feel.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、わかった！　おれ、お兄ちゃんパワーで、ちょっとみんなと合体してくる！」
lines.english: “Okay, got it! I'll use my Big Brother Power and go combine with everybody!”

lines.japanese: 「グッドラック。ハヴァ・ナイス・コンバイン」
lines.english: “Good luck. Have a nice combine.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー、コンドルさん。おれ、こんどは逃げないで上手く生きられっかな」
lines.english: “Hey, Condor. Think I can make a decent life of it this time without running away?”

lines.japanese: 「知ってるかい。世界なんて、おまえらみんなたちの心の中にあるチャンネルをひねれば、いくらでも変わってしまうものなんだぜ」
lines.english: “You know, the world can change any way you like if you all change the channel in your hearts.”

lines.japanese: 「新しいせかいも夢テレビとか夢ゲームみたいなトコだったらいいな」
lines.english: “I hope the new world is someplace like Dream TV or a dream game.”

lines.japanese: 「廻せ廻せ、チャンネル廻せ！」
lines.english: “Turn it, turn it—turn the channel!”

lines.japanese: 「みんながやさーしくて、おれが人気もので、ヤなこと全ぜんないーくて、まいんちずっとおもっしぇートコだったらいいな」
lines.english: “I hope everybody's nice, and I'm popular, and nothing bad ever happens, and every day is fun forever.”

lines.japanese: 「廻せ廻せ、どっかにあるさ！」
lines.english: “Turn it, turn it! It's out there somewhere!”
